fields.subject: DatabasesBase<TConfiguration>.DataConnection
fields.trigger: a caller invokes MapListAsync<TModel> or ListAsync<TValue>
fields.response: shall, for MapListAsync<TModel>, return the Task<List<TModel>> obtained directly from DataConnectionManager.ListAsync<TModel>; shall, for ListAsync<TValue>, absent a matching MockResults entry, forward the given columnName to DataConnectionManager.ListAsync<TValue, object, object> and return a List<TValue> built by projecting the Item1 value from each item the manager returns
